findings.needed_material: At prepare, verify and document the SC032 panel–regimen–strain–MIC–response associations and any supported exposure linkage. Record the checked outcome for MI001; keep the dependent regimen-level exposure-response decision pending while unresolved.

findings.reason: A50–A53 associate A. baumannii FADDI-AB051 with PMB MIC 0.5 mg/L, 45 mg/kg/day free base IP divided into three doses q8h, and terminal lung burdens. A54 states: No matched measured PK for these efficacy regimens. Administration timestamps, first-dose timing and a matched exposure input are NOT_FOUND on this page.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported complete dosing history and a justified exposure input linked to this efficacy experiment before treating these observations as matched regimen-level exposure-response records. Independent PD inventory remains available.

findings.reason: A50 identifies A. baumannii FADDI-AB051. These PMB efficacy observations are relevant source material for independent review, but R14 prohibits using other pathogens to establish K. pneumoniae targets.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of the permitted supporting use of this A. baumannii PD item; retain its organism identity and exclude it from K. pneumoniae target estimation.

findings.reason: Baseline, vehicle observations, lung-burden units and endpoint times are available. Host strain, immune status, inoculum, infection-to-treatment interval, explicit treatment duration, MIC method, medium, testing standard, replicates and summary definition are NOT_FOUND. Only one PMB regimen is retained, so this page does not demonstrate dosing-frequency variation for index ranking. PK-to-PD compatibility cannot be assessed from matched measured PK here.
findings.needed_material: If this item is proposed for an eligible downstream response-linked analysis, obtain the missing experimental and MIC context and source-supported exposure compatibility. Retain index ranking and target estimation as unresolved; this item cannot supply K. pneumoniae targets.
